title: Rizia/Turn 10/BDAY FALLOUT
description:
HUGO, LUCITA AND/OR TADDEUS WAS ON COUNCIL BUT YOU CONQUERED THEIR HOUSE AND KILLED OR ARRESTED THEM

ELENA AND LAURENTO FEEDBACK + NATDES ENDS IF APPLICABLE

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sat at the long table in my counc..."
entries.dialogueText: I sat at the long table in my council chambers, facing Elena and Laurento.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I hope you are well today, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you are well today, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Indeed... We seem to be having a c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed... We seem to be having a cold spell of late. But I am certain spring is just around the corner."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They both spoke in somewhat unnatur..."
entries.dialogueText: They both spoke in somewhat unnatural tones. I saw flashes of fear in their eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come on, you two... it's just me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, you two... it's just me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know the events of my mother's b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know the events of my mother's birthday seemed rather extreme. But trust me, it had to be done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is something wrong, councilors?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is something wrong, councilors?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Correct, Mr. Esquibel. The daffodi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Correct, Mr. Esquibel. The daffodils in the Palace gardens have already begun to bloom."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""N-no, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "N-no, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Not at all.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not at all."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I do not doubt it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I do not doubt it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Oh, I wasn't aware I was acting ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I wasn't aware I was acting out of the ordinary. Please accept my apologies."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""How lovely...""
entries.dialogueText: "How lovely..."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: !(RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_SecurityCouncilorGone == true && (RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_CouncilMeeting_HugoGone == true || RiziaDLC.Council_GrandVizier_Empty == true))

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They glanced at each other."
entries.dialogueText: They glanced at each other.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Such actions are sometimes necessa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such actions are sometimes necessary for the health of the realm."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""And mine, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "And mine, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With the... departure of our Grand..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the... departure of our Grand Vizier and Duchess Azaro, there are now two spots on the council that need filling."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With the... departure of our Grand..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the... departure of our Grand Vizier and General Azaro, there are now two spots on the council that need filling."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Fortunately, we're quite close to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, we're quite close to the Hearing of Petitions. I'm sure you'll be able to find suitable candidates to fill both seats."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Remember that your own seat on thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember that your own seat on this council is by no means guaranteed. Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Despite their treachery, they were..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite their treachery, they were competent advisors. They leave big shoes to fill."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It makes no difference in the end...."
entries.dialogueText: "It makes no difference in the end. *I* am the one making the decisions. You people are nothing but leeches."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There are still a few months to go..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are still a few months to go. I trust you to help me run the country in the meantime."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We'll do our best.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll do our best."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Yes, we're... aware of that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we're... aware of that."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Yes, I agree.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I agree."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I have never once taken it for gra..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have never once taken it for granted."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Both Azaro generals are committed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both Azaro generals are committed to seeing it through, despite the fate of their House and Duchess."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento checked his notes."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento checked his notes.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It appears the transfer of all thr..."
entries.dialogueText: "It appears the transfer of all three provinces to Crown control is well underway."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It appears the transfer of Valenqi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It appears the transfer of Valenqiris and Cardesse-Montaklar to Crown control is well underway."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It appears the transfer of Cardess..."
entries.dialogueText: "It appears the transfer of Cardesse-Montaklar to Crown control is well underway."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The Crown Princess continues to re..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Crown Princess continues to reside in Palas Toras in Monqiz. All other members of the noble houses in question have been vacated from their estates."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It appears the transfer of Cardess..."
entries.dialogueText: "It appears the transfer of Cardesse-Montaklar and Brenas to Crown control is well underway."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""All members of the noble houses in..."
entries.dialogueText: "All members of the noble houses in question have been vacated from their estates."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""All Azaros have been vacated from..."
entries.dialogueText: "All Azaros have been vacated from their estates."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""All members of the noble houses in..."
entries.dialogueText: "All members of the noble houses in question, including your cousin Hubertus, have been vacated from their estates."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""They shall live as commoners, with..."
entries.dialogueText: "They shall live as commoners, with no special privileges or entitlements."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She allowed herself a small, grim s..."
entries.dialogueText: She allowed herself a small, grim smile.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Naturally, the seizure of their es..."
entries.dialogueText: "Naturally, the seizure of their estates will bring a substantial boost to our treasury. Some of their assets, however, were held offshore."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With the... departure of your uncl..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the... departure of your uncle from the council, the Grand Vizier seat will need filling."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Fortunately, we're quite close to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, we're quite close to the Hearing of Petitions. I'm sure you'll be able to find a suitable candidate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My uncle was a competent advisor...."
entries.dialogueText: "My uncle was a competent advisor. He leaves big shoes to fill."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With the... departure of our secur..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the... departure of our security councilor, there is a seat at this table that needs filling."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Fortunately, we're quite close to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, we're quite close to the Hearing of Petitions. I'm sure you'll be able to find a suitable candidate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lucita was a competent advisor. Sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita was a competent advisor. She leaves big shoes to fill."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Taddeus was a competent advisor. H..."
entries.dialogueText: "Taddeus was a competent advisor. He leaves big shoes to fill."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That was not the reason behind my..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was not the reason behind my actions. But I admit it's a nice bonus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perfect. I have big plans for that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perfect. I have big plans for that funding."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That money should go straight into..."
entries.dialogueText: "That money should go straight into the hands of the people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that so? I should have done thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that so? I should have done this a long time ago."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With regards to the ongoing war in..."
entries.dialogueText: "With regards to the ongoing war in Pales..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""General Carlos Robles Azaro is com..."
entries.dialogueText: "General Carlos Robles Azaro is committed to seeing it through, despite the fate of his relatives."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With luck, they should finally be..."
entries.dialogueText: "With luck, they should finally be able to bring the Princess home."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With regard to the ongoing Pales r..."
entries.dialogueText: "With regard to the ongoing Pales reunification talks..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Duke Reinhart has shown a willingn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart has shown a willingness to continue the process. But he does warn that your 'lack of respect for Rizia's provincial autonomy' has given him pause."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""His words, not mine.""
entries.dialogueText: "His words, not mine."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Her Excellency Queen Beatrice, mea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Her Excellency Queen Beatrice, meanwhile, has sent us a telegram praising your show of dominance over Rizia's wayward nobility."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""President Wiktor Smolak, meanwhile..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Wiktor Smolak, meanwhile, has sent us a telegram praising your show of dominance."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Prime Minister Saltana of Morella..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana of Morella has notified us that while she is not against the expropriation of noble estates in principle, she does question the method by which we have done so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Splendid. Anything else I should k..."
entries.dialogueText: "Splendid. Anything else I should know?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Fortunately, international blowbac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, international blowback over the... incident... has been minimal. Especially since few specifics have been leaked to the world at large."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To be in charge of a nation someti..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be in charge of a nation sometimes requires one to make bold decisions. Our trade partners know that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The world must know that the King..."
entries.dialogueText: "The world must know that the King of Rizia is not to be messed with."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""One other thing, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "One other thing, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want anyone to get the wro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want anyone to get the wrong idea. This was a defensive measure, not some sort of power grab."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I will try to communicate that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will try to communicate that."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Most certainly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Most certainly."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""This doesn't fall under either of..."
entries.dialogueText: "This doesn't fall under either of our purview, but with the security councilor indisposed..."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It's our proud duty to tell you th..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's our proud duty to tell you that the unrest that has plagued Rizia for so long has come to an end."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""You'll hear more about this from y..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll hear more about this from your security councilor, but for now..."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""That will be it for now. I'm sure..."
entries.dialogueText: "That will be it for now. I'm sure you have a lot of work to do."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The concessions we were forced to..."
entries.dialogueText: "The concessions we were forced to make to the protesters did negatively impact our economy."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Miraculously, the concessions we w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Miraculously, the concessions we were forced to make to the protesters barely dented our economy."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The upheaval we experienced did ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "The upheaval we experienced did negatively impact our economy."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Miraculously, the upheaval we expe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Miraculously, the upheaval we experienced barely dented our economy."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Our energy reserves are still reco..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our energy reserves are still recovering from the sabotage incident. It may take some time before we're at our former capacity."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Thanks to your quick actions after..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to your quick actions after the sabotage incident, our energy reserves are on track to reach their former capacity."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""And we remain in debt to Rizian Ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we remain in debt to Rizian Royal Gold. I hope it isn't too late for that to be squared."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Our robust energy reserves will un..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our robust energy reserves will undoubtedly help us weather the months ahead."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Thankfully, we have adequate energ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thankfully, we have adequate energy reserves to weather the months ahead."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I am concerned that our energy res..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am concerned that our energy reserves are insufficient to weather the months ahead."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Concerning news. But at least we'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Concerning news. But at least we're now in the position to begin working on our recovery."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With the anti-monarchists out of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the anti-monarchists out of the way, our economy will soar even higher than before."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We handled the unrest. We can hand..."
entries.dialogueText: "We handled the unrest. We can handle Rusty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is still much work to be don..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is still much work to be done. We've got to address the root cause of the uprising, not just recover from it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We should take some time to rest o..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should take some time to rest on our laurels. We defeated a revolution, after all."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Indeed. No easy feat.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. No easy feat."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I have no doubt it will, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no doubt it will, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Very prudent thinking, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very prudent thinking, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""And work we will, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "And work we will, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I am sure we can.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am sure we can."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God be praised!""
entries.dialogueText: "God be praised!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you want, a medal? That's..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you want, a medal? That's literally the least that I expect."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""No medal necessary. Forgive me.""
entries.dialogueText: "No medal necessary. Forgive me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you quite sure?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you quite sure?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One less thing to worry about.""
entries.dialogueText: "One less thing to worry about."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The ringleader -- Adarfo, was it?..."
entries.dialogueText: "The ringleader -- Adarfo, was it? -- now sits in the Porte Drazon Citadel, awaiting your judgement."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""The ringleaders have all been arre..."
entries.dialogueText: "The ringleaders have all been arrested, and the movement has scattered to the winds."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Your decision not to resort to har..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision not to resort to harsh measures has apparently paid off."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Ms. Werner. And I'm sor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Ms. Werner. And I'm sorry again about all the recent unpleasantness."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wait...""
entries.dialogueText: "Wait..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, lots of work to be done. No t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, lots of work to be done. No thanks to my shrunken council."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They both paused."
entries.dialogueText: They both paused.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and Laurento stood up and bowed..."
entries.dialogueText: She and Laurento stood up and bowed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let recent events be a lesson to y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let recent events be a lesson to you. Nobody goes against Romus Toras and lives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good day to you both.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good day to you both."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You both served my father for year..."
entries.dialogueText: "You both served my father for years. Would he have been proud of what I did?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I lost my wife. My heir. I have no..."
entries.dialogueText: "I lost my wife. My heir. I have no one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I lost my uncle. My closest adviso..."
entries.dialogueText: "I lost my uncle. My closest advisor. I have no one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing. You're both dismissed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing. You're both dismissed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They both looked uncomfortable."
entries.dialogueText: They both looked uncomfortable.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I am sorry, Your Majesty. This can..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry, Your Majesty. This cannot be easy for you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They both looked uncomfortable."
entries.dialogueText: They both looked uncomfortable.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He would have understood, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "He would have understood, Your Majesty. Reigning is not easy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Their faces both paled."
entries.dialogueText: Their faces both paled.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Understood, Your Majesty. We would..."
entries.dialogueText: "Understood, Your Majesty. We would never dream of doing so."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It was for the greater good.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was for the greater good."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I kept my eyes on my oldest and mos..."
entries.dialogueText: I kept my eyes on my oldest and most loyal councilors as they departed my chambers.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Still, something is better than no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, something is better than nothing. We’ll take what we can get."
